claims.claim: Boeing's T-7A remained in the US Navy UJTS competition through 2026.
By October 2026 all 16 contracted Protector air vehicles had been delivered into service.
Estonia completed 28 pilot bunkers for the Baltic Defence Line.
Eutelsat's IRIS2 low-orbit component contracts awarded in 2026 total less than 1 billion euros.
Germany became a full partner of GCAP in 2026.
Greece reduced its FDI frigate order to two ships in 2025.
In 2026 Vulcan flew its national-security missions on schedule without interruption.
In 2026 the US Navy awarded Raytheon a contract modification of about 833 million dollars for more ESSM Block 2 missiles.
Leonardo selected Shield AI to integrate Hivemind autonomy into Proteus.
Naval Group delivered the second FDI frigate, HS Nearchos, to the Hellenic Navy in 2026.
Northrop Grumman pulled out of the team bidding for the US Navy UJTS trainer.
Poland received a first batch of 28 K2 tanks under the second executive contract.
Poland's second executive contract for K2 tanks covers 360 tanks.
Spain's first F110 frigate, Bonifaz, was launched behind schedule.
The Defense Logistics Agency committed the full 2 billion dollars of the National Defense Stockpile allocation.
The European Commission opened a second SAFE funding round worth about 21 billion euros.
The Proteus uncrewed helicopter had not flown by mid-2026.
The US Army HADES Prototype 1 completed its first flight in October 2026.
The third Pohjanmaa-class corvette was launched in October 2026.
UK Boxer vehicle deliveries ran on schedule throughout 2025.
